about_the_game:
I Got Isekai’d into A Shmup


After an exhausting day… You return home with your new shmup in hand.
Black out!
You wake up in the midst of a space battle!
Choose to be one of the four pilots and hold the fate of this world in your hands!

Game Features

  • Playable for 1 to 4 players: Invite your friends for an intense cooperative experience!
  • 4 game modes: Normal, Difficult, Maniac, and Boss Rush! (The Boss Rush requires to finish the game and isn't available in the demo).
  • Explore 8 unique stages (in the full version of the game, this demo only includes 2 stages), each with its own challenges and secrets.
  • Select from 4 ships with varied shooting styles.
  • Unlock bonus scenes to delve deeper into the story.
  • Collect and complete a mysterious bestiary.
  • Aim high with 45 unlockable achievements. (only 8 are available in the demo).
  • Compete against friends with scoreboards for each difficulty level.
  • Support screen rotations, play as you like.
  • And to top it all off, an epic soundtrack, fueled by custom-made instrumental metal! 🎶🤘

    Get ready to dive into the action, dodge tons of bullets, and save this world teetering on the edge of chaos! 🚀💥

short_description: I Got Isekai’d Iito a Shmup is a vertical shoot’em up game inspired by the best games of the 90s genre, while adding exciting features and local co-op for up to 4 players. It caters to both casual players and hardcore arcade fans through its various game modes.
